air.title: Созвон по срыву сроков
air.situation: Пятничный созвон: четверо из разных стран обсуждают, почему испытания сдвигаются. Говорят быстро и перебивают друг друга.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Okay, let's get started. We've got a problem with the schedule, so I want to hear from everyone. Oliver, you first.

lines.speaker: oliver
lines.text: Right, so the long and short of it is the shaker table's gone down again — it's the amplifier, not the table itself — and the earliest they can get a replacement out to us is Wednesday.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Wednesday. And how long do the vibration tests take once it's back?

lines.speaker: oliver
lines.text: Three days if nothing goes wrong, so realistically we're looking at the end of next week.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Sorry, can I jump in? If vibration slips, can't we just swap the order and do the thermal cycling first? The chamber's free from Monday.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: We could, but mate, the thermal procedure assumes the panel's already been through vibration. We'd have to get that signed off by quality.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: That's me. I'm not against it in principle, but I'd need a short note explaining why the order doesn't affect the results. If I get it by Monday morning, I can approve it the same day.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Okay, so here's the plan. Priya writes the note over the weekend, Grace reviews it Monday morning, thermal cycling starts Monday afternoon, and vibration picks up when the amplifier's fixed. Does that work for everyone?

lines.speaker: oliver
lines.text: Yep, I'll chase the supplier and let you know if Wednesday slips.

doc.title: Effect of manufacturing defects on the compressive strength of sandwich panels
paragraphs: Honeycomb sandwich panels are widely used in spacecraft structures because they combine high bending stiffness with low mass. However, their compressive strength is sensitive to manufacturing defects such as core crushing, skin wrinkles and disbonds between the skin and the core. This study quantifies the effect of these defects on the edgewise compressive strength of aluminium honeycomb panels with carbon fibre skins.

Forty-eight panels measuring 300 by 200 millimetres were manufactured in four groups: pristine panels and panels with artificial core crushing, skin wrinkles or disbonds. Disbonds were introduced by placing a 25-millimetre PTFE film between the skin and the core before curing. All panels were inspected by ultrasonic C-scan and then loaded to failure in edgewise compression at a rate of 0.5 millimetres per minute.

Pristine panels failed at a mean load of 86 kilonewtons with a coefficient of variation of 4 percent. Core crushing reduced the strength by only 3 percent, which is within the scatter of the pristine group. Skin wrinkles reduced the strength by 11 percent, while disbonds caused the largest reduction of 27 percent. In all disbonded panels, failure started with local skin buckling over the disbond.

The results suggest that disbonds are the most critical defect for compressive loading and should be given priority in inspection. Because a 25-millimetre disbond is reliably detected by C-scan, the authors recommend C-scan inspection of every flight panel, whereas visual inspection is considered sufficient for core crushing.

register.situation: Заказчик в ярости из-за задержки. Первая фраза ответа?
options: Thank you for your email, and I understand your frustration about the delay.
register.why: Признай чувства и поблагодари — это снижает накал. Оправдания и «успокойтесь» только злят.

register.why: Конкретная дата и регулярные новости возвращают доверие.

write.task: Ответь заказчику. Отчёт задерживается на неделю из-за повторного испытания (первый образец был повреждён при установке). Новый срок — 14 марта. Предложи еженедельные апдейты.
write.incoming:
Dear Ivan,

This is the second time the report has been delayed. We had a design review planned based on your data, and now we have to postpone it. I need to understand what is going on and when we will actually get the results.

Regards,
Grace Walker
Quality Manager
write.model:
Dear Grace,

Thank you for your email, and I understand your frustration — I'm sorry the delay affects your design review.

The first specimen was damaged during installation, so we had to repeat the test to make sure the results are valid. The repeat test was completed yesterday, and the data look consistent.

We will deliver the final report by 14 March. Until then, I will send you a short progress update every Friday. If it helps, I can also share the preliminary results this week so that you can prepare for the review.

Kind regards,
Ivan Petrov
checklist: признал проблему и извинился один раз
